select cls,
  cast(fish_date_doy/10 as int)*10 as bucket,
  sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) as ypa,
  count(*) as n
from trips
where fish_date_season=6 and fish_date_doy between 240 and 279
  and cls in ('THREE_QUARTER','DAY_1_5','OVERNIGHT')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2
select cls, count(*), max(fish_date_doy) from trips where fish_date_season=6 group by 1 order by 1

select cls,
  cast(fish_date_doy/10 as int)*10 as bucket,
  sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) as ypa,
  count(*) as n
from trips
where fish_date_season=6 and fish_date_doy between 240 and 274
  and cls in ('three_quarter','day_1_5','overnight')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2
